source.prompt: A flat, front-on decorative panel, square, 2048x2048, on a solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff). Orthographic, flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no cast shadows, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The pattern must repeat: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Three horizontal registers of ornate bobbin-lace and metallic-thread passementerie trim bands running seamlessly from left to right, woven with scalloped floral rosettes, diamond guipure brides, and picot-loop lower edges; every openwork aperture and gap between registers shows only the solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff) through it. Neutral mid-grey (#8a8a8a), fully desaturated, so the lace can be tinted gold, silver, cream or black. Hard clean edges against the magenta (#ff00ff), no anti-aliased fringe of other colours. No magenta, pink or purple anywhere in the subject.
